_about: One 'Pairs well with' pack per listing page, or none. pack = slug in content/packs/packs.json, or null. why = shown on the card (keep it true to what the pack contains). reason = internal note for null entries, not shown. Every listing must have an entry (checked at build).

agent-skills.reason: Agent Builder has 2 Claude Code skills, but only for MCP servers and evals; not a general skills pack.

agents-md.reason: No pack is built around AGENTS.md files in general (the game-dev AGENTS.md files are engine-specific).
